verdict.rationale: W&B ships an official MCP server, documented and confirmed by a GitHub repo, that gives coding or chat agents direct access to traces, evaluations, runs and artifacts so they can answer debugging questions. The Weave Service API also offers REST endpoints for programmatic access. Missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of agent-driven debugging, and explicit documentation that metrics (beyond runs, traces and evaluations) can be queried through these interfaces.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can have an agent query my traces, metrics, and eval results through an API or MCP server to debug my app

citations.quote: The W\&B MCP Server gives your IDE, coding assistant, or chat agent direct access to your W\&B data and documentation... your agent can answer questions about your runs, traces, evaluations, and artifacts without copy-paste.
Use the Weave Service API, which provides REST endpoints for programmatic access to Weave functionality.
Using W&B skills and the MCP server, coding agents like Claude Code connect to Weave. They can read live production data, run evaluations, and execute automatic iteration loops on their own
official MCP server documented at https://github.com/wandb/wandb-mcp-server
